The person has difficulty to distinguishing between reality and imagination. It is often shown in adolescence or early childhood. They have difficulty expressing normal emotions.
sections.what_are_the_schizophrenia_signs_and_sym: Schizophrenia Symptoms may vary from person to person. The common Schizophrenia signs and symptoms are explained below:

 Reduced feeling of happiness in their life, reduced normal expressions (flat affect) like facial or voice tone.
